parameters.content:
## 📊 Review Summarizer
POST `/webhook/review-summary` with `{product, reviews:[{rating,text}]}` or `{demo:true}`.
Heuristic themes always computed; LLM writes verdict+reply with template fallback.

parameters.responseBody:
={{ '

📊 Nothing to summarize

POST JSON like {\"product\":\"Desk\",\"reviews\":[{\"rating\":5,\"text\":\"great\"}]} or {\"demo\":true}

' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-v4-flash', temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 300, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You summarize product reviews for shop owners. Reply with STRICT JSON only — no markdown fences.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.llmPrompt } ] }) }}
